IMPLEMENTATION SUMMARY:
- scripts/qa-prep.sh: 2-stage script (dist via vite build skipping tsc; sidecars copy-from-canonical or build). Group-kill timeout via set -m + background watchdog (mirrors test-capped.sh). Detects canonical checkout via git worktree list --porcelain. Symlinks node_modules from canonical if missing. --timeout flag + QA_PREP_TIMEOUT env override. --force-build-sidecars for explicit rebuild. sidecar_valid() checks >1MB before reusing.
- build.sh: added 'qa-prep' case (delegates to bash scripts/qa-prep.sh ${@:2}). Added 'qa-prep' to usage line. Added warm CARGO_TARGET_DIR auto-detection in 'dev' case: if not already set, detects canonical checkout, exports canonical/src-tauri/target — so ./build.sh dev in any worktree is warm without user action.
- docs/LANES.md: rule 3 extended with one-line dev-start-waits note; revision bumped to 2.
GATES REQUESTED: orchestrator run 'git worktree add /tmp/ct-qa-test lane/460103461-qa-prep && cd /tmp/ct-qa-test && ./build.sh qa-prep --timeout 180' in a fresh worktree; capture 2nd-run timing (should be fast for dist; sidecars copy in <1s from canonical). Verify dist/index.html present and bundled-cli/codeterm + bundled-embed/codeterm-embed-<triple> are >1MB. Then run ./build.sh dev and confirm 'Using shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR' line appears.

GATE FINDING — qa-prep is blocked by build.sh's hard prod-port guard (line 138: CT_PORT=7685 -> exit 1). qa-prep never targets a daemon/port, yet an orchestrator running inside a PROD pane (its exact intended user) inherits CODETERM_API_PORT=7685 and can't run it. Real usability bug: qa-prep must be exempt from the port guard (it's pure build-prep like build/cli/check). Verifying the qa-prep dist+sidecar logic now via a port override; will bounce the guard-exemption fix to the worker.

GATE PASS (logic) — ran build.sh qa-prep in a detached fresh worktree (port-override to bypass the guard). Stage 1 vite build (no tsc) -> dist/index.html in 1.75s, node_modules symlinked from canonical. Stage 2 sidecars reused from canonical (cli 11.7MB, embed 30MB, both >1MB, no redundant release build). Staged output + group-kill timeout + ready message all present. Acceptance met EXCEPT the port-guard blocker below.

FIX: Changed 'if [ "$CT_PORT" = "7685" ]' to 'if [ "$CT_PORT" = "7685" ] && [ "$CMD" != "qa-prep" ]' at the hard exit guard. qa-prep uses no daemon/port so the guard is irrelevant; an orchestrator in a prod pane (CODETERM_API_PORT=7685 inherited) can now run ./build.sh qa-prep without needing a port override.
NOTE: build|cli|check|test|clean|env are also daemon-less but not changed — keeping scope to qa-prep as instructed. If those should be exempted too, that's a separate PR.

GATE GREEN + ACCEPTED — guard fix verified from the REAL scenario: ./build.sh qa-prep with inherited prod CODETERM_API_PORT=7685 and NO override -> rc=0 cold 3s / warm 2s; guard no longer blocks (first output line is the vite stage, not the refuse-prod error). dist/index.html OK, cli 11.7MB + embed 30MB reused from canonical. All AC met (one-command dev-prep, no tsc, sidecar reuse, staged+timeout, 2nd-run warm timing=2s). Accepting to done.
